reasons: Rule kind is 'missing' and the finding is supported: no insurance covenant exists in the agreement, and TrueLink is a hosting vendor processing consumer credit/mortgage data, squarely within the rule's scope (walk-away if uninsured).

Inserted Section 31 tracks the model language closely (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to Client data, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) and is placed in the miscellaneous section as the redline guidance directs; no existing text is altered, so the edit is minimal.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, and offers the fallback (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) as a negotiation position.

Deterministic checks pass; the noted survival-clause cross-reference ('Sections 1 and 5 through 30') is a minor conforming point already disclosed in the rationale and does not undermine the insert's enforceability.
